filters._comment_min_net_apr_pct: RAISED 5.0 -> 48.0. Gross funding-spread threshold, sized to clear the 23.7% break-even at the new 48h hold with ~2x margin. Round trip is 0.130% (Extended taker 0.025% + Pacifica taker 0.040%, both legs, entry and exit).

trading._comment_hold_time_hours: RAISED 23 -> 48. Break-even APR = roundtrip_fee_pct * (8760/hold_hours). At 23h the break-even was 49.5% against a 5.0 threshold, so most accepted rotations lost ~0.13% each; 57 rotations ran under those settings. At 48h the break-even is 23.7%.

notes.description: Configuration for funding rate arbitrage opportunity finder and bot
notes.min_combined_volume_usd: Minimum 24h volume in USD (Extended + Pacifica combined)
notes.max_intra_exchange_spread_pct: Maximum bid-ask spread % within each exchange (Extended and Pacifica)
notes.min_net_apr_pct: Minimum GROSS APR % (the funding-rate spread between the two venues). WARNING: 'net' here means net of the other leg's funding ONLY - it is NOT net of trading costs. No fee term exists anywhere in the entry filter. Verified round-trip cost for this pair is 0.130% (Extended taker 0.025% + Pacifica taker 0.040%, both legs, entry and exit), so at hold_time_hours=23 the true break-even is 49.5% APR. A setting of 5.0 accepts trades that lose money on ~10 out of every 10 cycles.
notes.max_position_size_usd: Maximum notional USD value per position (applied per exchange, limited by available capital)
notes.hold_time_hours: Time in hours to hold a position before considering rotation (default: 48)
notes.fetch_timeout_seconds: HTTP request timeout for API calls
notes.rate_limit_delay_ms: Delay between sequential requests to avoid rate limiting
notes.bot_behavior: Bot monitors every 15 minutes, holds positions for configured hold_time_hours before rotation, uses 95% of minimum available capital (capped by max_position_size_usd), uses market orders with 5 retry attempts
